shared_elements: radiating fan / frond-like motif with splayed lines
repeated motifs set in a row
linear division of the field into zones by a straight band or stem line
schematic outlined forms without interior modelling
justification: The only concrete correspondence is a splayed, radiating frond/palmette-like form and the use of a straight line to divide or organise repeated motifs, both rendered as flat schematic outlines. Otherwise the content differs fundamentally: A is a purely vegetal composition of alternating palmettes, rosettes and drooping blossoms strung along a continuous vertical stem, while B shows horizontal registers dominated by heavy-limbed quadruped-like or figural forms, with no repeating floral chain.
